hypotheses.construction_plan: Define latent object F(z)=psi(z). Apply the identity operator to F to obtain polygamma(0,z). Apply the derivative operator d/dz to F to obtain polygamma(1,z). The raw expression is the sum of these two generated members.
required_assumptions: polygamma(n,z) exists for n=0,1 and z in domain where derivatives are defined
hypotheses.rationale: Both members are the first two members of the polygamma derivative family; polygamma(1,z) is the derivative of polygamma(0,z) with respect to z, so the expression is a sum of a function and its derivative.
